confirmed.stackStringIdentical: clone stack == live stack, byte for byte; the ONLY delta is the missing @font-face

roundUpAgainstStaticFallback.claim: 1472 rules request font-weight:510 and 76 request 590, which round UP against a static fallback
roundUpAgainstStaticFallback.finding: FALSE. The fallback .SF NS is a VARIABLE font and Chrome instantiates the exact requested axis value.
roundUpAgainstStaticFallback.evidence: CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode postScriptName at w510 = .SFNS-Regular_wdth_opsz200000_GRAD_wght1FE0000 (0x1FE0000 / 65536 = 510.0); at w590 = ..._wght24E0000 (= 590.0); at w500 = ..._wght1F40000 (= 500.0). Advance widths vary continuously and monotonically across 300..800 with 510 strictly between 500 and 600.
roundUpAgainstStaticFallback.impact: weight is faithfully reproduced; the defect is typeface substitution only, not weight snapping

inkCost.finding: NOT REPRODUCIBLE as stated. n=240 real strings, identical text/size/weight/letter-spacing, black on white, DSF2.
inkCost.impact: under the physically honest definitions the clone has SLIGHTLY LESS ink than the source, not more. The +9..+42% figure is only approachable under 'count every pixel an antialiasing fringe touches', where the +30% at w510 comes with only +7% actual ink mass -> the metric conflates AA spread with weight. Sign flips negative at weight 400, which is 64% of rendered text runs.

rewrap.claim: re-wrapping on nearly every multi-line block
rewrap.finding: FALSE. 152 of 683 multi-line runs change line count when the real font is restored at the clone's own container widths = 22.3% of multi-line runs, 7.7% of all 1974 unique runs.
rewrap.pageScale: restoring fonts changed full-page document height by exactly 0px on 6/6 route+viewport pairs (r000001 d/m, r000005 d/m, r000008 d/m)

narrowerAdvances.finding: central value in range, range itself overstated as uniform. n=1974 unique real strings at their real size/weight/letter-spacing.
narrowerAdvances.honestStatement: median 2.8% narrower; p5-p95 spans -1.2% to +4.6%; a quarter of runs show no measurable narrowing

topWeightCause.claim: fonts are a top-weight visual cause
topWeightCause.finding: ROUTE-DEPENDENT, and FALSE on the worst route.
topWeightCause.impact: the homepage, the highest-changedRatio accepted pair at 0.2073, still sits at 0.1974 with perfect fonts. Fonts are necessary-but-far-from-sufficient there; they only dominate on text-heavy, media-light routes.

denominatorCaveats.wave1ChangedPixelThreshold: any R/G/B channel differs by >= 1 -> counts every antialiasing pixel
denominatorCaveats.note: the headline changedRatio band 0.0235..0.4953 is a >=1/255 metric; at a perceptual threshold (>=32) r000001 desktop is 0.0382, not 0.2073. Wave-1 states its rule honestly in metrics.json, but the number should not be read as 'fraction of visibly different pixels'.
denominatorCaveats.ruleVsRenderedDenominator: 1472/76 are CSS declaration-block counts. Only 997 and 92 RENDERED text runs (of 3069 harvested across 8 routes at desktop) actually carry weight 510 / 590.
denominatorCaveats.captureCountAsymmetry: claim cites 24 clone captures vs 16 live captures without explaining the different denominators (3 viewports vs 2)
